bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, broke $190, closed at the low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖，跌破 $190，收于日内低点

read.en: Nvidia fell 9.3% on Nov 5 to $181.60, trading between $181.46 and $196.25 and closing near the low on volume nearly three times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($199.0), 10-day ($206.9), 30-day ($219.8) and 100-day ($214.2) averages and the rising 200-day ($204.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($211.58), and RSI is 25.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月5日下跌 9.3%，收于 $181.60，盘中区间 $181.46–196.25，收盘接近日内低点，成交量接近 20 日均量的三倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$199.0）、10 日（$206.9）、30 日（$219.8）和 100 日均线（$214.2）以及上行的 200 日均线（$204.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$211.58），RSI 为 25。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $198–199.7, $194.7 and $189.8–191.1 supports in one session; the $196.25 high stayed under the Nov 4 low. Resistance is $189.8–191.1 (Jun 29, Jul 29 and Jul 7 lows), then $194.7–196.3 (May 4 low, Nov 5 high) and $198–200.1. Support is $179.2–179.9 (Feb 17 and Mar 13 lows), then $176.8–177.6 and $164.3 (52-week low, Mar 30). A close above $191.1 would target $195–196; below $179.2, $177.
